title: RemediationItem Contract
description: Schema for remediation backlog items (B-001 through B-029). Used to track remediation work across all 4 phases.

title.description: Short title of the remediation task

depends_on.description: List of item IDs this item depends on (items that must complete first)

gate_condition.description: Criterion for item success (e.g., 'Sharpe unchanged or improved', 'DSR > 0.5')

gate_result.description: Result of gate evaluation after execution

decision_rationale.description: Why item passed, failed, or was deferred

remediated_strategy.description: Which strategy this item remediates (null if infrastructure/audit)

examples.title: Fix momentum-strategy-audit prompt
examples.description: Rewrite audit prompt to use specification-as-code pattern with citation requirements; false positives currently prevent reliable verification
examples.gate_condition: Audit agent correctly identifies J&T deviations; test with deliberate violations

examples.title: Fix R8 rebalance cadence (252d → 21d)
examples.description: Change R8 rebalance from annual (252d) to monthly (21d) per Barroso & Santa-Clara (2012) spec; annual defeats vol-scaling purpose
examples.gate_condition: Sharpe unchanged or improved post-fix; vol-control metrics validated
